question.title: v5.0.0 Full Production Promotion roadmap plan-time review (PR-X0 plan doc + projection manifest + master plan amend)
question.body: AO-MA-SPM master plan §Faz 1-7 program 2026-06-01'de tamamlandi (7/7 fazlar MERGED, main f1dc032). v4.1.0 release lifecycle akiyor (PR #769 11G-2a merged, PR-B 11G-2b in CI). Kullanici sordu: 'urun tam production icin neler kaldi? Plan olusturup GitHub'a ekleyelim (gorunurluk).' Bu istisare: v5.0.0 Full Production Promotion roadmap'i hazirlamak ve GitHub-native gorunurluk (Milestone + Issues + Project board + plan doc) icin ready_for_impl AGREE almak.

plan_verdict: Codex iter-1 REVISE (8 missing invariants: production_ready_semantics flag flip degil evidence matrix sonucu; visibility_not_authority mirror SSOT degil; v5_source_manifest 80 issue tek seferde acma projection manifest + lazy expand; guard_flip_path AO-MA-11A normal yetmez operator-bound supersession ayri; tenant_isolation_claim ayri epic; final_promotion_decision roadmap sonunda tek PR flag flip o PR'da; issue_scale_control epic + P0 gate ilk dalga; public_claim_language production-ready final PR'a kadar yok) + revize 4-PR yapisi (PR-X0 plan + projection + acceptance matrix; PR-X1 master plan amend; PR-X2 GH mirror sync post-11E-2; PR-Xfinal flag flip). Bagimlilik sirasi: P0 runway -> Epic 1 follow-up -> Epic 2 live adapter -> Epic 3 support widening -> Epic 4-8 paralel -> Epic 9 final promotion. Multi-tenancy ayri Epic 4 (Observability altinda DEGIL). 8 epic -> 9 epic (Promotion Governance P0 ayri).
status_note: PR-X0 (PR-X1 dahil; combined plan doc + projection + master plan amend); 3-dosya scope (.claude/plans/V5-...md + v5_issue_projection.v1.json + AO-MA-SPM-MASTER-PLAN.md amend + local-ai-review-evidence.v1.json + CNS); allowlist'li paths; .github'a dokunmaz; otonom merge beklenir. PR-X2 (GH mirror sync) 11E-2 sonrasi; PR-Xfinal flag flip TUM evidence sonrasi.
resolution: Codex thread 019e80b3 iter-1 REVISE absorb: 8 missing invariants spec'e gomuldu, multi-tenancy ayri epic, 9 epic + P0 (10 toplam parent), revize 4-PR yapisi. ready_for_impl=true Codex iter-2 sonrasi (henuz post-impl review almadi; PR-X0 commit + push + Codex post-impl review iter -> AGREE -> otonom merge).
